description: Cultuurhistorie- DNA-kaart, Inundatiegebieden is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.gelderland.nl. File with inundation areas included in the so-called DNA map. In the cultural-historical policy of the province of Gelderland "Belvoir", Gelderland is divided into ten Belvoir areas. Each area has its own regional cultural-historical identities. The carriers of these identities are the DNA structures. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Cultural History - DNA Map, Inundation Areas" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2010-11-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
